elaine (PM): Ok team — consolidating the field asks for Private deployments. Can we list the non-negotiable launch gates for VPC + on‑prem packaging and the minimum upgrade path guarantees customers expect?
vikram (SRE): High level: handshake reliability, predictable NAT behaviors, and clear routing fallbacks. If the agent loses connectivity, we need deterministic retry/backoff and local telemetry retention.
sara (Solutions): From the field: customers want a single outbound-only option (no inbound ports), KMS/HSM integration, and an easy fallback to a hosted model during upgrades. Also patch windows matter — they want rolling upgrades with zero config changes.
jay (Eng): For packaging constraints: image size budget (~4GB compressed), offline install bundle, and a migration tool that preserves KV caches across versions. Compat matrix: allow +1/-1 minor version during handshakes.
vikram (SRE): +1 on outbound-only. Add gating: if TLS handshakes fail for >5m, agent should switch to degraded read-only mode and surface an admin alert. Also require support for customer HTTP proxy + mTLS to control plane.
elaine (PM): Launch gates proposal draft: 1) Agent handshake success >= 99.5% in staging with sample customer network profiles, 2) Upgrade rollback < 15m for worst-case stateful nodes, 3) KMS integration test suite passing (rotate keys), 4) Airgap install docs + test. Thoughts?
sara (Solutions): Need a 1-pager for customers that lists supported network topologies (NAT, double-NAT, private link). Also call out ports, DNS, and common proxy errors. We keep hitting "proxy_auth_failed" during proofs.
jay (Eng): Implementation note - propose adding a small local HTTP status page and a `redwood-agent inspect-network` tool. Example output:
```
$ redwood-agent inspect-network
OK: outbound 443
WARN: proxy auth required
INFO: kv-cache: 7.2MB
```
That helps field teams debug quickly.
vikram (SRE): Automation for upgrade paths: CI job that deploys previous stable -> candidate -> rollback. We should run this against our internal VPC and an onprem VM pool. If rollback fails, build must be blocked.
sara (Solutions): Also require documented handoff: runbook for field engineers with recovery steps and list of telemetry fields to collect. Customers ask for a template script to rotate certs.
elaine (PM): Good. Can we assign owners and minimal due dates? I propose: network docs (sara) - EOW, agent inspect tool (jay) - 2w, handshake tests + CI (vikram) - 3w, launch gate checklist (elaine) - 1.5w.
jay (Eng): Ack. I'll sketch the inspect tool and a small unit: `inspect-network` + `agent status --json`. Will push a prototype branch.
vikram (SRE): I'll wire up the CI smoke for upgrade/rollback and add the 5m degraded-mode test. Need a test matrix for NAT/proxy permutations — @sara can you paste the common customer profiles?
sara (Solutions): Pasting quickly:
- corp-proxy: corporate proxy with basic auth, outbound 443 TLS through proxy
- nat-setup: double NAT with ephemeral ports
- private-link: AWS PrivateLink to control plane
I'll add more in the doc.
deploy-bot: New artifact available: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4871 (agent v0.9.3-rc) :rocket:
elaine (PM): Thanks. Next check-in in 3 days to review progress and lock the final launch gate wording. If anything blocks the EOW docs, flag here. :handshake:
